channel_conventions.deck_rows: deck rows carry ch=1; the unit sends on deck channel 1-4 (status 9n/Bn, n=deck-1). Left side = deck 1/3, right side = deck 2/4 via DECK SELECT.
channel_conventions.pad_rows: pads 1-4 on ch 6-9, pads 5-8 on ch 10-13 (deck 1-4); note = 19*(pad index mod 4) + mode offset
channel_conventions.channel_assignment: ch1 browser (shared with deck 1), ch1-4 decks, ch5 effect+mixer, ch6-13 pads, ch14 jog display / LOAD LED (MIDI OUT)
